name: device_ping
title: Device ping
description: Confirms that the AutoJs6 MCP Server plugin is reachable and returns its version, the device model, the Android API level, and the device time.

name: device_info
title: Device info
description: Returns the device build, screen, battery, memory, AutoJs6 host version and process, accessibility service state, screen state, locale, and time zone as AutoJs6 reports them (schema autojs6-bridge-device-info-v1). No hardware identifiers.

name: script_run
title: Run script
description: Runs JavaScript source in AutoJs6 (its Rhino engine with the full AutoJs6 API) and by default waits for it to finish. Use it for automation steps: toasts, UI actions, file work, app launches. The result carries executionId, status (finished, error, running), durationMs, the exception with its line when the script threw, and the newest console lines. A script still running after the wait keeps running: script_stop stops it, script_list shows it, console_tail follows its output.

name.description: Script name shown in the AutoJs6 task list; AutoJs6 appends .js itself, a given .js suffix is dropped

workingDirectory.description: POSIX-style path relative to the AutoJs6 working directory; the script cannot escape it

arguments.description: Values exposed to the script through engines.myEngine().execArgv

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the script to finish, in milliseconds; a script still running afterwards is not killed

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for the script to finish before answering; false returns the executionId at once

captureConsole.description: Include the console lines printed while the script ran

maxConsoleLines.description: Keep at most this many of the newest console lines

name: script_run_file
title: Run script file
description: Runs a script file that already exists on the device (AutoJs6 picks the engine from the suffix) and by default waits for it to finish. The result carries executionId, status (finished, error, running), durationMs, the exception with its line when the script threw, and the newest console lines. A script still running after the wait keeps running: script_stop stops it, script_list shows it, console_tail follows its output.

path.description: POSIX-style path of the script file, relative to the working directory; it cannot escape it

workingDirectory.description: POSIX-style path relative to the AutoJs6 working directory; the script cannot escape it

arguments.description: Values exposed to the script through engines.myEngine().execArgv

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the script to finish, in milliseconds; a script still running afterwards is not killed

waitForCompletion.description: Wait for the script to finish before answering; false returns the executionId at once

captureConsole.description: Include the console lines printed while the script ran

maxConsoleLines.description: Keep at most this many of the newest console lines

name: script_stop
title: Stop script
description: Stops one running AutoJs6 script by the executionId that script_run, script_run_file, or script_list reported.

executionId.description: Execution id of the script to stop

name: script_stop_all
title: Stop all scripts
description: Stops every script AutoJs6 is running, including ones started on the phone, and returns how many were stopped.

name: script_list
title: List scripts
description: Lists the scripts AutoJs6 is running or starting, with executionId, name, path, working directory, state, and uptime.

name: console_tail
title: Console tail
description: Returns the newest lines of the AutoJs6 console, which every script shares; optionally only entries after sinceId or at least a level. nextSinceId in the result continues from where this call ended.

lines.description: How many of the newest lines to return

sinceId.description: Only entries with an id above this one (the nextSinceId of a previous call)
